attributes.name: Diurgez Broodlord
attributes.powers:
Diurgez Broodlord cannot be evaded and is immune to the Electricity, Fire, and Poison traits. All damage dealt by Diurgez Broodlord is Poison damage.

If undefeated, reset your hand and expend 1d4+2 mythic charges; if you die, uncheck 1 skill feat or 1 card feat. (If there are multiple adjacent checked boxes, the one you uncheck must be the farthest to the right.)

If defeated, each character at your location rolls 1d20; if a character rolls a number less than or equal to her hand size, she discards her hand. Then, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Diurgez Broodlord, change the second power to "If undefeated, reset your hand and expend 1d4+2 mythic charges; if you die, uncheck 1 skill feat or 1 card feat."
corrections.issue: Diurgez Broodlord says "if you die, uncheck 1 skill feat or 1 card feat." But Diurgez Broodlord can't kill you—he can only wipe your hand. Also, what are "mythic tokens"?
